full_script: Come on, let's enjoy the magic of maths together! Ravi and Priya at the sweets shop. 110 sweets, but Ravi takes 5 first! Now 110 minus 5 leaves us with 95 sweets. How do we split them? Detective scale shows 47 and a half each! But no halves in sweets! Balancing scales like solving equations. Which topic next? Comment below! Which NCERT topic should we explore next? Tell me in the comments!
